_meta.source: NHTSA FARS 2023 national accident CSV (county-level) + US Census county population
_meta.method: County traffic-fatality rate per 100k, shrunk toward the state rate with weight pop/(pop+100,000) so small counties are not dominated by noise, then normalized so the highest county = 100 (same semantics as the state file). Centers are matched to the nearest county centroid; a center further than 60 mi from any centroid keeps its state score.
_meta.limitations: Nearest-centroid matching has no county boundaries behind it, so a center near a county line may be attributed to its neighbour. match_distance_miles is recorded per center so that error is visible.
